# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Read the root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the authoritative project instructions. Follow `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md`, `docs/TASKS.md`, and `docs/DEMO.md` as appropriate.

Prioritize the running 12-hour hackathon MVP: SpacetimeDB as the real-time source of truth; a synthetic, first-party-only decoy collector; and verified Photon 2.0 iMessage/inbound voice where access allows. Do not send automated retaliatory traffic to real endpoints. Treat all live integrations as unverified until an actual round trip has succeeded.
